race.description: Save The Date Warwick Cup 10th October Hcp (55)
race.comment: STREET DAZZLER (8) tends to get back in her races, and with the right tempo up front, she can finish off her races strongly, as she did when running on late for third at Gatton just over 3 weeks ago. Each-way claims again. HUMAN TOUCH (5) has been freshened up since having no favours on an unsuitable track at Toowoomba just over 6 weeks ago. She showed what she is capable of when winning there fresh up, and she can make amends in this. BEAU'S GIRL (7) should have finished closer at Rockhampton last time out when following on from a couple of solid efforts to start this campaign before that. Ash Butler sticks with her, and so do we. TAYLOR'S RAGE (9) was perfectly placed in a soft field when scoring third up at Inverell 17 days ago, and she won't find this field much tougher. Stick with her on an each-way basis.
